searchText: <@412614104222531604> <@467031582146822144> New channel dedicated for L2s. Thanks so much <@412614104222531604> and team! Context: This was motivated by our (OP Labs') desire to participate in EF devnets well in advance of testnet activations (and getting genesis allocations in these devnets, etc.). Should be useful for other kinds of collaboration as well. <@459963806450450432> maybe let arb guys know too about this new channel. We gonna try to keep this channel focused on L2 change set Speaking of the devnets <@412614104222531604>, let me know if there's anything else you need from us regarding genesis allocations (address should be `0x107781Bc6FA8f66B843f4216fd6D5862D3aa4fcd`).
